#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_set>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int a, b, l, r;
    cin >> a >> b >> l >> r;

    string fin;
    for (int i = 0; i < a; i++)
        fin.push_back('a' + i);
    for (int i = 0; i < b; i++)
        fin.push_back('a' + a - 1);

    int x = l % (a + b);
    if (x == 0)
        x = a + b;
    fin = fin.substr(x - 1);

    // First padding block
    unordered_set<char> set;
    for (int i = fin.length() - 1; i >= 0 && i >= (int)fin.length() - a; i--)
        set.insert(fin[i]);
    int op = a;
    for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z' && op > 0; c++) {
        if (set.count(c))
            continue;
        fin.push_back(c);
        op--;
    }
    char ch = fin.back();
    for (int i = 0; i < b; i++)
        fin.push_back(ch);

    // Second padding block
    set.clear();
    for (int i = fin.length() - 1; i >= 0 && i >= (int)fin.length() - a; i--)
        set.insert(fin[i]);
    op = a;
    for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z' && op > 0; c++) {
        if (set.count(c))
            continue;
        fin.push_back(c);
        op--;
    }
    ch = fin.back();
    for (int i = 0; i < b; i++)
        fin.push_back(ch);

    // Count distinct characters from 0 to min(r-l, fin.length()-1)
    set.clear();
    int len = r - l;
    for (int i = 0; i <= len && i < (int)fin.length(); i++)
        set.insert(fin[i]);
    cout << set.size() << endl;

    return 0;
}
